def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]

    seed_time = pd.Timestamp(seed_time)
    idx = pd.Index(entity_ids, name="product_id")

    # --- Базовая таблица: позиции заказов, совершённых строго до seed_time ---
    df = order_items.merge(
        orders[["order_id", "order_purchase_timestamp",
                "order_delivered_customer_date", "order_estimated_delivery_date"]],
        on="order_id", how="left"
    )
    df = df[df["order_purchase_timestamp"] < seed_time].copy()

    rev = reviews[reviews["review_creation_date"] < seed_time][["order_id", "review_score"]]
    rev_agg = rev.groupby("order_id").agg(
        review_score_mean=("review_score", "mean"),
        review_count=("review_score", "count"),
        review_pos_ratio=("review_score", lambda x: (x >= 4).mean()),
    ).reset_index()

    # --- Платежи: только те, что известны к моменту seed_time ---
    pay = payments[payments["ts"] < seed_time]
    pay_agg = pay.groupby("order_id").agg(
        payment_sum=("payment_value", "sum"),
        payment_installments_mean=("payment_installments", "mean"),
        payment_count=("payment_sequential", "count"),
    ).reset_index()

    df = df.merge(pay_agg, on="order_id", how="left")
    df = df.merge(rev_agg, on="order_id", how="left")

    df["days_before"] = (seed_time - df["order_purchase_timestamp"]).dt.days
    df = df[df["product_id"].isin(entity_ids)]

        & (df["order_delivered_customer_date"] < seed_time)

        (df["order_delivered_customer_date"] - df["order_estimated_delivery_date"]).dt.days

            "avg_review", "pos_review_ratio", "review_count",
            "delivered_ratio", "avg_delay_vs_estimate"]]
        return pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=idx, columns=cols)

    def window_features(data, window_days):

            avg_review=("review_score_mean", "mean"),
            pos_review_ratio=("review_score_mean", lambda x: (x >= 4).mean()),
            review_count=("review_count", "sum"),
            delivered_ratio=("delivered_before_seed", "mean"),
            avg_delay_vs_estimate=("delay_vs_estimate", "mean"),
        )
        g.index.name = "product_id"

    else:
        prev = df[(df["days_before"] >= 30) & (df["days_before"] < 60)]

        sum_prev = prev.groupby("product_id")["price"].sum().reindex(idx, fill_value=0)
        features["count_trend_30d"] = features["30d_count"] - cnt_prev
